_info: Notbad base language file. Keys starting with "_" are ignored. To translate: copy this file as <locale>.json (for example pt-BR.json) and change only the values. Keep the printf specifiers (%s, %d, %u, %%) of each value exactly as in English, and keep the \t shortcut part of menu items.
